use crate::policy::{CostPlane, Meter};
use crate::*;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

fn failure(code: &str, message: impl Into<String>) -> Error {
    Error::new(code, message)
}
pub(crate) fn identifier(name: &str) -> bool {
    let mut bytes = name.bytes();
    matches!(bytes.next(), Some(b'A'..=b'Z' | b'a'..=b'z'))
        && name.len() <= 64
        && bytes.all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_')
        && !matches!(
            name,
            "language"
                | "agreement"
                | "state"
                | "asset"
                | "action"
                | "input"
                | "let"
                | "next"
                | "requires"
                | "ensures"
                | "emit"
                | "transfer"
                | "fee"
                | "liability"
                | "discharge"
                | "true"
                | "false"
                | "and"
                | "or"
                | "not"
                | "UInt"
                | "Bool"
        )
}
fn names<'a>(values: impl Iterator<Item = &'a str>, kind: &str) -> Result<(), Error> {
    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
    for name in values {
        if !identifier(name) || !seen.insert(name) {
            return Err(failure(
                "duplicate",
                format!("Invalid or duplicate {kind} name {name:?}."),
            ));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
pub(crate) fn expr_type(
    program: &Program,
    id: ExprId,
    env: &BTreeMap<String, Type>,
    depth: usize,
) -> Result<Type, Error> {
    type_cached(
        program,
        id,
        env,
        depth,
        &mut vec![None; program.expressions.len()],
    )
}
fn type_cached(
    program: &Program,
    id: ExprId,
    env: &BTreeMap<String, Type>,
    depth: usize,
    cache: &mut [Option<Type>],
) -> Result<Type, Error> {
    if depth > 64 {
        return Err(failure("bound", "Expression depth exceeds 64."));
    }
    let index = usize::from(id);
    let node = program
        .expressions
        .get(index)
        .ok_or_else(|| failure("expression", "Expression index out of bounds."))?;
    if let Some(ty) = cache[index] {
        return Ok(ty);
    }
    let result = match node {
        Expr::LiabilityPresent { .. } => Ok(Type::Bool),
        Expr::LiabilityAmount { .. } => Ok(Type::UInt),
        Expr::Literal { value } => Ok(value.ty()),
        Expr::Name { name } => env
            .get(name)
            .copied()
            .ok_or_else(|| failure("name", format!("Unknown or forward name {name:?}."))),
        Expr::Not { value } => {
            if type_cached(program, *value, env, depth + 1, cache)? != Type::Bool {
                return Err(failure("type", "not requires Bool."));
            }
            Ok(Type::Bool)
        }
        Expr::Binary { op, lhs, rhs } => {
            let a = type_cached(program, *lhs, env, depth + 1, cache)?;
            let b = type_cached(program, *rhs, env, depth + 1, cache)?;
            let expected = match op {
                BinaryOp::And | BinaryOp::Or => Type::Bool,
                _ => Type::UInt,
            };
            if a != b || (!matches!(op, BinaryOp::Eq | BinaryOp::Ne) && a != expected) {
                return Err(failure("type", "Binary operands have incompatible types."));
            }
            Ok(
                if matches!(op, BinaryOp::Add | BinaryOp::Sub | BinaryOp::Mul) {
                    Type::UInt
                } else {
                    Type::Bool
                },
            )
        }
    }?;
    cache[index] = Some(result);
    Ok(result)
}
/// Validates even manually constructed/deserialized IR before interpretation.
pub fn validate(program: &Program) -> Result<(), Error> {
    if program.language != LANGUAGE || program.semantics != SEMANTICS {
        return Err(failure(
            "profile",
            "Unsupported language or semantics identity.",
        ));
    }
    if !identifier(&program.name) {
        return Err(failure(
            "name",
            "Agreement name must be a non-reserved ASCII identifier of at most 64 bytes.",
        ));
    }
    if program.actions.is_empty() {
        return Err(failure("program", "Program needs at least one action."));
    }
    if program.states.len() + program.assets.len() + program.actions.len() > MAX_DECLARATIONS
        || program.expressions.len() > MAX_EXPRESSIONS
    {
        return Err(failure(
            "bound",
            "Program exceeds finite declaration/expression bounds.",
        ));
    }
    names(
        program
            .states
            .iter()
            .map(|s| s.name.as_str())
            .chain(program.assets.iter().map(|a| a.name.as_str())),
        "declaration",
    )?;
    names(program.actions.iter().map(|a| a.name.as_str()), "action")?;
    let mut identities = BTreeSet::new();
    for asset in &program.assets {
        let id = &asset.identity;
        if id.network.is_empty()
            || id.issuer.is_empty()
            || id.reference.is_empty()
            || id.network.len() > 1024
            || id.issuer.len() > 1024
            || id.reference.len() > 1024
            || id.scale > 38
            || !identities.insert(id)
        {
            return Err(failure(
                "asset",
                "Asset identities must be complete, unique and use scale 0..38.",
            ));
        }
        if program.assets.iter().any(|other| {
            other.identity.network == id.network
                && other.identity.issuer == id.issuer
                && other.identity.reference == id.reference
                && other.identity.scale != id.scale
        }) {
            return Err(failure(
                "asset",
                "Same asset identity cannot have conflicting scales.",
            ));
        }
    }
    let mut depths = Vec::with_capacity(program.expressions.len());
    for (i, e) in program.expressions.iter().enumerate() {
        let refs = match e {
            Expr::Binary { lhs, rhs, .. } => vec![*lhs, *rhs],
            Expr::Not { value } => vec![*value],
            _ => vec![],
        };
        let mut depth = 0;
        for r in refs {
            if usize::from(r) >= i {
                return Err(failure(
                    "expression",
                    "Expression references must point to earlier nodes; cycles are forbidden.",
                ));
            }
            depth = depth.max(depths[usize::from(r)] + 1);
        }
        if depth > 64 {
            return Err(failure("bound", "Expression depth exceeds 64."));
        }
        depths.push(depth);
    }
    let state_types: BTreeMap<_, _> = program
        .states
        .iter()
        .map(|s| (s.name.clone(), s.ty))
        .collect();
    for state in &program.states {
        if state.initial.ty() != state.ty {
            return Err(failure(
                "type",
                format!("Initial state {:?} has wrong type.", state.name),
            ));
        }
    }
    for action in &program.actions {
        if action.inputs.len() > MAX_DECLARATIONS || action.statements.len() > MAX_STATEMENTS {
            return Err(failure(
                "bound",
                "Action exceeds input or statement bounds.",
            ));
        }
        names(action.inputs.iter().map(|i| i.name.as_str()), "input")?;
        let mut env = state_types.clone();
        for input in &action.inputs {
            if env.insert(input.name.clone(), input.ty).is_some()
                || program.assets.iter().any(|a| a.name == input.name)
            {
                return Err(failure("duplicate", "Input cannot shadow a declaration."));
            }
        }
        for statement in &action.statements {
            match statement {
                // Same identity as `stage::require_core1`; only an in-memory
                // program can carry Await here, since `/1` JSON cannot.
                Statement::Await { .. } => {
                    return Err(failure("profile", "Await requires moriarty-core/2."));
                }
                Statement::Let { name, value } => {
                    let ty = expr_type(program, *value, &env, 0)?;
                    if !identifier(name)
                        || env.insert(name.clone(), ty).is_some()
                        || program.assets.iter().any(|a| a.name == *name)
                    {
                        return Err(failure("duplicate", "let cannot shadow an existing name."));
                    }
                }
                Statement::Requires { predicate } | Statement::Ensures { predicate } => {
                    if expr_type(program, *predicate, &env, 0)? != Type::Bool {
                        return Err(failure("type", "Predicate must have type Bool."));
                    }
                }
                Statement::Next { state, value } => {
                    let expected = state_types
                        .get(state)
                        .ok_or_else(|| failure("name", format!("Unknown state {state:?}.")))?;
                    if expr_type(program, *value, &env, 0)? != *expected {
                        return Err(failure("type", "State update has wrong type."));
                    }
                }
                Statement::Emit { name, value } => {
                    if name.is_empty() || name.len() > 1024 {
                        return Err(failure("name", "Event name must contain 1..1024 bytes."));
                    }
                    expr_type(program, *value, &env, 0)?;
                }
                Statement::Transfer {
                    asset,
                    from,
                    to,
                    amount,
                }
                | Statement::Fee {
                    asset,
                    from,
                    to,
                    amount,
                } => {
                    validate_asset(program, asset)?;
                    if from.is_empty() || to.is_empty() || from.len() > 1024 || to.len() > 1024 {
                        return Err(failure("account", "Account identities cannot be empty."));
                    }
                    require_uint(program, *amount, &env)?;
                }
                Statement::Liability {
                    name,
                    asset,
                    debtor,
                    creditor,
                    amount,
                } => {
                    validate_asset(program, asset)?;
                    if name.is_empty()
                        || debtor.is_empty()
                        || creditor.is_empty()
                        || name.len() > 1024
                        || debtor.len() > 1024
                        || creditor.len() > 1024
                    {
                        return Err(failure(
                            "liability",
                            "Liability identities cannot be empty.",
                        ));
                    }
                    require_uint(program, *amount, &env)?;
                }
                Statement::Discharge { name, amount } => {
                    if name.is_empty() || name.len() > 1024 {
                        return Err(failure(
                            "liability",
                            "Liability name must contain 1..1024 bytes.",
                        ));
                    }
                    require_uint(program, *amount, &env)?;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    validate_liability_reads(program)?;
    Ok(())
}
// New reads require a source-fixed identity. Legacy Core external duties and
// discharge-only programs keep their existing validation rules.
pub(crate) fn validate_liability_reads(p: &Program) -> Result<(), Error> {
    let mut reads = BTreeMap::new();
    for expr in &p.expressions {
        if let Expr::LiabilityPresent { name } | Expr::LiabilityAmount { name } = expr {
            if name.is_empty() || name.len() > 1024 {
                return Err(failure(
                    "liability",
                    "Liability read name must contain 1..1024 bytes.",
                ));
            }
            reads.insert(name.as_str(), None);
        }
    }
    for stmt in p.actions.iter().flat_map(|a| &a.statements) {
        if let Statement::Liability {
            name,
            asset,
            debtor,
            creditor,
            ..
        } = stmt
            && let Some(found) = reads.get_mut(name.as_str())
        {
            let identity = (
                validate_asset(p, asset)?,
                debtor.as_str(),
                creditor.as_str(),
            );
            if found.is_some_and(|previous| previous != identity) {
                return Err(failure(
                    "liability",
                    format!("Conflicting source liability identity for {name:?}."),
                ));
            }
            *found = Some(identity);
        }
    }
    for (name, identity) in reads {
        if identity.is_none() {
            return Err(failure(
                "liability",
                format!("Liability read {name:?} has no source-derived identity."),
            ));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn require_uint(
    p: &Program,
    id: ExprId,
    env: &BTreeMap<String, Type>,
) -> Result<(), Error> {
    if expr_type(p, id, env, 0)? != Type::UInt {
        Err(failure(
            "type",
            "Financial amount requires UInt atomic units.",
        ))
    } else {
        Ok(())
    }
}
pub(crate) fn validate_asset<'a>(p: &'a Program, name: &str) -> Result<&'a AssetId, Error> {
    p.assets
        .iter()
        .find(|a| a.name == name)
        .map(|a| &a.identity)
        .ok_or_else(|| failure("asset", format!("Unknown asset {name:?}.")))
}

<END XV>

## H07: HISTORICAL provenance/expectations: main71-HEADER-DIAGNOSTIC.patch

Whole-body SHA256: 8931f6b177d0b1515b9e587f2bd45e483636689294dad0b47647fafc438089e3; bytes: 3018; delivery: full.

<BEGIN H07>
diff --git a/crates/mori-core/src/parser.rs b/crates/mori-core/src/parser.rs
index 34262724..8ecb3c18 100644
--- a/crates/mori-core/src/parser.rs
+++ b/crates/mori-core/src/parser.rs
@@ -394,14 +394,24 @@ pub fn language(source: &str) -> Result<&'static str, Error> {
             actions: vec![],
         },
     };
-    parser.expect("language")?;
-    let profile = parser.string()?;
+    let expected = format!(
+        "language \"{LANGUAGE}\" or \"{}\"",
+        crate::stage::LANGUAGE_2
+    );
+    parser.expect("language").map_err(|mut error| {
+        error.message = format!("Expected {expected}. {}", error.message);
+        error
+    })?;
+    let profile = parser.string().map_err(|mut error| {
+        error.message = format!("Expected {expected}. {}", error.message);
+        error
+    })?;
     match profile.as_str() {
         LANGUAGE => Ok(LANGUAGE),
         crate::stage::LANGUAGE_2 => Ok(crate::stage::LANGUAGE_2),
         _ => Err(parser.error(
             "profile",
-            format!("Expected language \"{LANGUAGE}\"; found {profile:?}."),
+            format!("Expected {expected}; found {profile:?}."),
         )),
     }
 }
diff --git a/crates/mori-core/tests/language.rs b/crates/mori-core/tests/language.rs
index 4c43ee59..95a7226a 100644
--- a/crates/mori-core/tests/language.rs
+++ b/crates/mori-core/tests/language.rs
@@ -424,3 +424,52 @@ fn quoted_operators_cannot_become_syntax() {
         r#"language "moriarty/1"; agreement Quoted { action run() { requires 1 = "=" 1; } }"#;
     assert!(parse(source).is_err(), "quoted tail cannot form equality");
 }
+
+#[test]
+fn language_header_diagnostics_name_both_supported_core_profiles() {
+    for (source, expected) in [
+        (
+            r#"language "moriarty/1"; agreement Example {}"#,
+            "moriarty/1",
+        ),
+        (
+            r#"language "moriarty/2"; agreement Example {}"#,
+            "moriarty/2",
+        ),
+    ] {
+        assert_eq!(language(source).unwrap(), expected);
+    }
+
+    let expected = r#"Expected language "moriarty/1" or "moriarty/2""#;
+    for (source, code, offset, suffix) in [
+        (
+            r#"language "other";"#,
+            "mori::core::profile",
+            16,
+            r#"; found "other"."#,
+        ),
+        (
+            "",
+            "mori::core::syntax",
+            0,
+            r#". Expected "language"; found ""."#,
+        ),
+        (
+            "agreement Empty {}",
+            "mori::core::syntax",
+            0,
+            r#". Expected "language"; found "agreement"."#,
+        ),
+        (
+            "language ;",
+            "mori::core::syntax",
+            9,
+            ". Expected a quoted string.",
+        ),
+    ] {
+        let error = language(source).unwrap_err();
+        assert_eq!(error.code, code, "{source:?}");
+        assert_eq!(error.offset, Some(offset), "{source:?}");
+        assert_eq!(error.message, format!("{expected}{suffix}"), "{source:?}");
+    }
+}
<END H07>

from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,tempfile,time
R=Path('/home/charl/moriarty-c2-opus55-restored-20261017')
K=Path('/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/utxo-core2-complete-20261018')
P=R/'public-cli-profile-guidance-main79-20261018'

HEAD='f91f2c7f1b3bf2229d1243fc6a1f9ee37004a209'
TC=Path('/home/charl/.rustup/toolchains/1.99.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
now=lambda:datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def write(name,x):
 p=C/name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n')
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=K).decode().strip()
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==HEAD and not git('status','--porcelain=v1')
tree=git('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}')
assert tree=='ed8323c00f31deaace461bf63db0365e8c4e0aac'
paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','--name-only',HEAD,'crates','Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','rust-toolchain.toml','docs/NATIVE-CORE.md'],cwd=K).decode().splitlines()
pins=[]
for path in paths:
 raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',HEAD+':'+path],cwd=K);assert(K/path).read_bytes()==raw,path
 pins.append({'path':path,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
write('SOURCE-PINS.json',{'head':HEAD,'tree':tree,'files':pins})

configs=[]
for directory in [K,*K.parents,root/'cwd',*(root/'cwd').parents]:
 for n in ['config','config.toml']:
  p=directory/'.cargo'/n
  if str(p) not in configs:assert not p.exists(),str(p);configs.append(str(p))
write('CHECK-PLAN.json',{'recordedAt':now(),'head':HEAD,'tree':tree,'base':'71c22f8a477231be869786eb42f04e3b50d1b3a7','sourceManifestSha256':sha(P/'MANIFEST.json'),'environment':env,'ownedRoot':str(root),'absentAncestorCargoConfigs':configs,'toolPins':[{'path':str(p),'sha256':sha(p)} for p in [TC/'cargo',TC/'rustc',TC/'rustdoc',Path('/usr/bin/timeout'),Path('/usr/bin/bash')]],'scope':'Exact integrated CLI/schema and public header regression plus six public source-check cases and five syntax commands. Existing per-command90s ceilings; no evaluator/SDK/native/proof/key/wallet/ledger action.'})
def run(name,argv,bound):
 d=C/name;d.mkdir();argv=['/usr/bin/timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=5s',str(bound)+'s',*argv]
 write(name+'/START.json',{'startedAt':now(),'argv':argv,'cwd':str(root/'cwd'),'head':HEAD,'tree':tree})
 start=time.monotonic()
 with(d/'STDOUT.log').open('wb')as out,(d/'STDERR.log').open('wb')as err:
  child=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=root/'cwd',env=env,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=out,stderr=err,start_new_session=True);write(name+'/CHILD.json',{'pid':child.pid,'session':child.pid});code=child.wait()
 remaining=[int(p)for p,s in(line.split()for line in subprocess.check_output(['ps','-eo','pid=,sid=']).decode().splitlines())if int(s)==child.pid]
 result={'finishedAt':now(),'exitCode':code,'wallSeconds':time.monotonic()-start,'stdoutSha256':sha(d/'STDOUT.log'),'stderrSha256':sha(d/'STDERR.log'),'ownedSessionRemaining':remaining};write(name+'/RESULT.json',result)
 assert not remaining;return result,d

 for block in manifest['rootShellSyntaxChecks']:
  file=P/block['path'];assert sha(file)==block['sha256']
  result,d=run('shell-'+str(block['block']),['/usr/bin/bash','-n',str(file)],10);results.append({'name':'shell-'+str(block['block']),**result});assert result['exitCode']==0 and not(d/'STDOUT.log').read_bytes()and not(d/'STDERR.log').read_bytes()
 assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==HEAD and not git('status','--porcelain=v1')and all(sha(K/p['path'])==p['sha256']for p in pins)
finally:
 shutil.rmtree(root)
 write('FINAL-RESULT.json',{'finishedAt':now(),'head':HEAD,'tree':tree,'results':results,'allEightCommandsCompleted':len(results)==8,'ownedRoot':str(root),'existsAfter':root.exists(),'scope':'Eight selected test cases, five shell syntax commands. Financial expectations remain exposed-author fixtures; twelve CLI byte assertions execute inside selected six tests, no separate twelve-stream captures. Full language/compiler/proof/native/ledger acceptance remains open.'})
 print(json.dumps({'allEightCommandsCompleted':len(results)==8,'ownedRootRemoved':not root.exists()}),flush=True)
